messages:
Aisha: Quick idea — run a small experiment for onboarding incentives for the next private preview cohort. goal: increase commitment rate and reduce no-shows without blowing budget.

Ben: +1. curious which incentives you're thinking (credits, SLA, 1:1 onboarding, swag?).

Aisha: Thinking 3 arms: (A) $500 platform credit + standard onboarding, (B) 2-week SLA bump + prioritized support, (C) dedicated 1-hour setup + small onboarding credit ($200). control = no extra incentive.

Liam: From SE POV: arm C probably reduces initial activation friction the most. we can offer a templated setup call and small runbook. low ops cost if we batch.

Priya: Suggest we add a qualitative check-in at day 7 for C to capture early blockers. short survey + optional call. that'll help us measure quality of feedback, not just signups.

Marco: Revenue concern — credits are easy but dilute short-term $$. SLA bump will require us to commit capacity reservations. need an estimate of incremental cost for B.

Elena: Ops note: SLA bump can be implemented as priority routing to dedicated pool for the cohort hours. we can timebox the window (e.g., PST 9am-5pm). estimate ~2 GPUs reserved for 2 weeks if cohort is ~20 customers.

Ben: How many seats for the experiment? i propose N=40 (10 per arm + control) to keep it manageable. we should randomize by signup time and product fit metric.

Aisha: N=40 sounds good. primary metric = accepted invite % within 7 days. secondary = engaged-seconds in week 1, qualitative usefulness score from survey.

Priya: For the qualitative score, propose 3 questions: 1) How runnable was the quickstart? (1-5) 2) Did the onboarding call resolve your blockers? (yes/no) 3) Will you recommend? (NPS-ish). Keep it <3 minutes.

Liam: I'll draft the onboarding template and runbook. can reuse existing private preview checklist. will add a checkbox for cached prefix setup.

Marco: For tracking, need coupon codes for credits (A, C). finance: I can own usage reconciliation. Elena can own capacity reservations for B.

Elena: Yep. will create a temporary routing policy and tag cohort requests. also need to add a cost cap guard to avoid accidental overrun.

Aisha: Timeline: recruit next week, randomize on signup cutoff Fri 9am, run experiment for 2 weeks of active onboarding, final results + recommendation in 3-week sync.

Ben: I'll own the recruitment messaging variants and headlines. also run a small prize headline experiment in outbox to boost click-through.

Priya: I'll wire the survey and a short interview plan (target 4 follow-ups across arms).

Liam: ops question — do we want to exclude accounts with prior dedicated capacity to avoid confounding?

Aisha: Yes exclude existing Dedicated/Private customers. keep only new entrants or hosted-only.

Marco: One more ask: add a conversion tag for downstream sales touch so we can track eventual convert-to-paid within 30 days.

Aisha: Good call. Ben/Marco coordinate on tagging.

deploy-bot: scheduled workflow created: experiment/onboard-incentives/3487654321, status: queued.

Aisha: ok next steps: Ben write recruitment copy by Tue, Liam prep runbook & template by Wed, Priya survey + interview script by Wed, Elena reserve capacity by Thu, Marco set up finance tags + coupons by Thu. i'll send calendar invite for the 3-week review. :white_check_mark:

Ben: added tasks to the board. leaving a comment about audience segmentation (we should prefer mid-stage startups + infra-focused PMs).

Priya: noted — will flag interview recruits accordingly.

Liam: will post setup snippets in #devex once ready.

Aisha: thanks team — if nothing else, we kickoff Fri morning.

Elena: quick FYI — capacity reservation might need legal review for SLA language if we promise uptime guarantees. looping legal now.

Marco: cool, keep me posted. if SLA wording is sticky, we can pivot to higher-priority support instead of formal SLA.

Aisha: noted. end-of-thread plan: run the 4-arm micro-experiment, report on acceptance %, week1 engagement, early qual feedback, and cost per accepted partner.

Priya: leaving a checklist comment on the experiment doc with consent language for interviews.

Ben: :rocket:
